description: Java class implementing a builder pattern for creating DittoHeaders objects, with methods for instantiation, initialization, and building headers.

classes.name: DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with a fluent API for creating DittoHeaders, not thread-safe, extending AbstractDittoHeadersBuilder.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder instance with an empty headers map.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder initialized with a given headers map or DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder initialized from a JsonObject.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Builds and returns the provided DittoHeaders object.
